name: My Obedient and Wild Lady
overview: Reborn after her husband’s betrayal, Shen Lingyi rewrites her destiny by marrying young marshal Gu Yunfei, a man hiding duty beneath a carefree façade. As war closes in, she uses her skills and foresight to rise from a sheltered daughter to a formidable partner, and the two join forces to uncover treachery and defend their nation.
